About Us

Jamiat Ulama RMD

A branch organization functioning under Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind, serving the local community through religious, educational, social and welfare initiatives.

About Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind

Jamiat Ulama RMD is a branch organization functioning under Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind (JUH), one of India’s oldest and most prominent socio-religious organizations, formally established in 1919. As a local branch, Jamiat Ulama RMD works in accordance with the principles, objectives and guidance of Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind, serving the local community through religious, educational, social and welfare initiatives.

Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind (JUH) is one of India’s oldest and most prominent socio-religious organizations, formally established in 1919. With a rich legacy rooted in the scholarly and reformist tradition of the Indian Ulama, Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind has played a significant role in the religious, social, educational and national life of India.

From its early involvement in the Indian freedom movement, the organization has stood for peaceful and democratic action, national unity and harmonious relations among people of different communities. Its members made significant contributions to the struggle against British colonial rule and advocated the principle of composite nationalism, emphasizing peaceful coexistence and cooperation among India’s diverse communities.

After India gained independence, Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind continued its work with a strong focus on protecting the religious, civil, cultural and educational rights of Muslims, while contributing to the welfare and development of society as a whole. Its activities include education, social reform, humanitarian assistance, relief and rehabilitation, legal support, and the protection of Islamic heritage and places of worship.

Our Vision

To protect Islamic faith, identity, heritage and places of worship, safeguard the civil, religious, cultural and educational rights of Muslims, and promote social, educational and religious reform for the progress and well-being of the community.

Our Mission

Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind seeks to foster peaceful and cordial relations among the diverse communities of India in accordance with the teachings of Islam. It also works towards the revival and advancement of Arabic and Islamic studies and the development of educational programmes suited to the needs of the modern age.

Our Commitment

Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind is committed to faith, education, social responsibility, justice, humanitarian service and national harmony. Through its extensive organizational network and various welfare and educational initiatives, it strives to empower communities, support those in need and contribute constructively to the progress of India.

Jamiat Ulama RMD

As a branch organization of Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind, Jamiat Ulama RMD is committed to carrying forward these principles and objectives at the local level. It strives to serve the community through religious guidance, educational development, social welfare, humanitarian service and initiatives that promote unity, peace and harmony in society.
